description: This file provides TypeScript types and functions for handling JSON-RPC messages within the project. It includes type guards, normalization, and validation functions specific to the JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol, assisting in message validation and type safety.

methods.name: function hasExclusiveResultOrError(value: Record<string, unknown>): boolean { hasExclusiveResultOrError
methods.description: Checks if a JSON-RPC message object has either 'result' or 'error', but not both, indicating a valid response object.

methods.name: export function isJsonRpcId(value: unknown): value is JsonRpcId { isJsonRpcId
methods.description: Type guard that determines whether a value is a valid JSON-RPC ID (string, number, or null).

methods.name: export function normalizeJsonRpcId(value: unknown): string | null { normalizeJsonRpcId
methods.description: Converts a value to a string JSON-RPC ID or null, if the value is a valid ID.

methods.name: export function isAcpJsonRpcMessage(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> { isAcpJsonRpcMessage
methods.description: Type guard that verifies whether an object conforms to an ACPL (assumed context) JSON-RPC message according to protocol specifications.
